analysis:
The PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch excerpt shows hunks at base 1129-1130 and head 1129-1132, 1143-1201 and 2205-2224. The patch excerpt is truncated and the range map covers head lines 1143-1201 and 2205-2224, which the patch does not display. The supplied units are base text only, covering lines 1636-2412. These units do not contain the changed head ranges, so I could not inspect those edits directly.

What I could see is the documented prefill-geometry change: Gemma 4 gets a wider prefill chunk (2048 chunk, 4096 step tokens) and a bidirectional-media prefill ceiling of 512. This is a documentation description of source behavior that I cannot verify against source. Capacity and DoS implications of wider prefill chunks (T-010, T-029, TB-007) depend on memory admission in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift, which was not supplied. The surrounding base text, the Flint section and the MiMo candidate, describes memory admission, media caps and fail-closed behavior, and I saw no weakening there.

No security controls, auth, attestation, encryption, T-041 prefix-cache documentation or threat-model assumptions are changed in the visible evidence. The base text of the Flint edit at head 2205-2224 lies in the Flint section, but I cannot see what changed there. I found no concrete security regression. Documentation-only changes cannot alter runtime behavior. A reviewer who has the head text should confirm that the head 1143-1201 and 2205-2224 edits make no new security claims, such as qualification, cache-exposure or media-limit claims, that contradict the threat model. Because those hunks were not visible, I set needs_deeper_review to true.
